prerequisites: at least 7 years of school knowledge in the foreign language

learning_outcomes.text: Students will typically have foreign language skills comparable to Level C1 of the CEFR (Common European Framework of Reference for Languages).
Students will possess sufficiently detailed knowledge of presentation techniques to present a demanding subject-specific topic to an international audience.
Students will have knowledge of other cultures and be able to successfully apply this knowledge in professional communication.
Students will master the confident use of the foreign language and work techniques to comprehend, reflect on, and discuss technical texts in a group.
Students will be able to communicate competently and expressively in the foreign language about complex technical issues with foreign interlocutors.
Students will have cultural empathy and thus be able to communicate confidently and successfully in an international context/team.

syllabus_topics: Exercises to train communication skills with current texts selected from technical specializations
Intensive training of presentation techniques based on technical topics
Group discussions of current technical topics
Cultural briefings and case studies to heighten awareness of intercultural differences
assessment_rules: The portfolio exam comprises 40 points and consists of an Oral Examination (M) and a Presentation with accompanying elaboration (R). A maximum of 20 points can be achieved with the Oral Examination, and a maximum of 20 points can also be achieved with the Presentation. The duration of the oral examination is as per the general part of the examination regulations. The presentation is approximately 10-12 minutes, with an accompanying elaboration of approximately 2-3 pages.
